stem:
Lalit draws a straight path that starts at point A, ends at point B, and does not continue past either point.

What has he drawn?

options.text: A line, because it is straight.
A ray starting at A and passing through B without ending.
A line segment AB, because it has two endpoints A and B.
A line segment even if he erases endpoint B and lets the path run on.

teacher.key_rationale: A line segment has two endpoints. Calling it a line uses the wrong label. A ray that does not end at B is a different object. Erasing B drops the two-endpoint condition.
